record.one_liner: Asana's platform provides a REST API with support for OAuth, Personal Access Tokens, and Service Accounts to extend and automate workflows.

auth_methods.quote: Here are the various authentication options and why you might want to use each of them... Personal access token... Service Account... OAuth... OpenID Connect

access_test.quote: You can test in any of your existing workspaces, create a free account, or request a developer sandbox .

access_ship.quote: If you are building an integration with a 3rd party tool and intend for any Asana user to discover it, apps can be published to the Asana App Directory .

api_type.quote: The Asana API is a REST ful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON, and uses standard HTTP features

api_breadth.quote: This reference is generated from our OpenAPI Specification , and contains a comprehensive reference for objects, schemas, and endpoints available in the API.
